Name: Pierre Sells Ginger Island Goods
Author: beyondrecovery
Description:
[size=3]Do you hate the grind of Ginger Island? Are you tired of digging up walnuts just to get into Mr. Qi's room only to learn that you’ve got to complete a bunch more tasks to acquire some gems to then trade back in for fertilizer recipes? Are you tired of scrounging for 2 pieces of radioactive ore at a time in the mines just so you can craft some hyper speed gro? Did you want to save those mussels for your growing seashell collection rather than trade them away for a banana sapling?
 
If you answered yes to any of these questions, then look no further: Pierre now sells fertilizers and seeds only available on Ginger Island. Beginning in [b]Year 2[/b], Pierre will [s]smuggle in[/s] sell [b]Deluxe Fertilizer[/b], [b]Hyper Speed-Gro[/b], [b]Deluxe Retaining Soil[/b], [b]Banana Saplings[/b], and [b]Mango Saplings[/b] all year round. He will also sell [b]Pineapple Seeds[/b] and [b]Taro Tubers[/b] when in season (summer).


[b]Updated for SDV 1.6
[/b]This mod now relies on Content Patcher instead of Shop Tile Framework. As a result, you can now configure the price of your Ginger Island goods without digging into the code.



[size=4][b]INSTALLATION[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.

[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.

[*]Download this mod


[*]Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder.

[*]Launch your game, reap the rewards!
[/list]

[/size]
